name: maisoncbdvape-eleventy
description: MaisonCBDVape — Site e-commerce JAMstack Eleventy + Cloudflare

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run css && npm run catalog && npm run verify:css && npm run verify:cms && npm run verify:api && npm run verify:redaction && eleventy
scripts.dev: wrangler pages dev public --kv ORDERS_KV --kv OAUTH_KV --r2 MEDIA --d1 STOCKS_DB
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public
scripts.db:seed: npm run stocks:seed && wrangler d1 execute maisoncbdvape-stocks --file=db/seed.sql --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run stocks:seed && wrangler d1 execute maisoncbdvape-stocks --file=db/seed.sql --local
scripts.db:etat: wrangler d1 execute maisoncbdvape-stocks --remote --command "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocks) AS references_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocks WHERE cle LIKE '%::%g') AS variantes_restantes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocks WHERE dispo = 10) AS encore_a_10, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mouvements) AS mouvements;"
